title: $H_2/H_{\infty}$ Control for Stochastic Differential Systems with Partial Observation
summary: This paper investigates the $H_{2}/H_{\infty}$ control problem for linear stochastic differential systems under partial observation. Unlike existing studies that assume full state accessibility, we consider the scenario where the controller has access only to an observation process. The objective is to design a controller that balances the $H_2$ performance criterion with the $H_\infty$ robustness requirement under worst-case disturbances, formulated as a nonzero-sum differential game.
